0022600131.text: Both teams are unbeaten through two games, with the Trail Blazers (2-0, 2nd in the Northwest, 4th in the West) visiting the Lakers (2-0, 1st in the Pacific, 1st in the West) for Portland's third game of the season. Portland is without Shaedon Sharpe, who is out with a knee injury (surgery), while Branden Carlson (concussion) and Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions, and Los Angeles is missing Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Cameron Carr (oblique strain), both out. There have been no meetings yet in 2026-27, and Portland won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 132-116 win in Portland on January 17, 2026.
